system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

See also: Starship Maneuvers

This maneuver allows a Pilot to take a quick action while engaged in a Dogfight after being the target of an attack.

[Dogfight]

Time: Reaction

Targets: Self

Make a Pilot check. The result of the check determines the effects, if any:

DC EFFECT
20 You may immediately take one Swift Action.
25 You may immediately take one Move Action.
30 You may immediately take one Standard Action.

Special: You may activate this maneuver only as a Reaction to being attacked by another Vehicle with which you are engaged in a Dogfight. The result of the attack is resolved before you take your Action, and the Initiative Order is not modified by this maneuver.
